title: Merge-conflict repair fixture issue
description:
## Issue Setup

- UAT Required: Yes

## Issue Goal

Exercise the merge lane write-mode path for a dirty PR that can be handled as safe merge-lane repair.

## Issue Context

This issue is loaded by `examples/merge-conflict-repair-fixture-workflow.md`. It is already in `Merging` and carries fixture linked pull request metadata with `merge_state_status: DIRTY` so the merge lane can rehearse conflict-repair evidence without touching a live branch.

## Non-Negotiable Guardrails

- Do not perform live GitHub or git branch mutation from this fixture.
- Keep the issue in `Merging` after synthetic repair so a later pass can re-evaluate mergeability.
- Route non-fixture dirty PRs to human input if a clean local PR worktree and safe repair path are not available.

## Scope

### In Scope

- Controlled fixture-mode `DIRTY` repair rehearsal.
- Durable merge attempt evidence before any state mutation.

### Out of Scope

- Live conflict resolution.
- Product-scope changes.

## Verification

### Completion Criteria

- `cargo run -- merge loop examples/merge-conflict-repair-fixture-workflow.md --max-iterations 1 --write` reports `safe_conflict_repaired` and keeps the issue in `Merging`.

### Functional Verification

- `cargo test merge_lane`
- `cargo fmt --check`

### UAT

- Run the controlled write-mode conflict repair fixture rehearsal.
